Hello blacksmiths,

We want to reassure all of You that game is still in development. After receiving feedback from our publisher we are busy with optimization, improving the dialogues, adding new languages, and overall debugging. We will need few more months to polish the game.

notes.title: Ironsmith - Alduran's Gate outskirts
notes.content:
Hello fellow blacksmiths,

Today we would like to show you a short video of an area on the new map.

This part are Alduran's Gate outskirts which includes farms, mines and rural areas.  

Alduran's Gate city has its name because of the ancient tale about a dragon who had his nest in the mountains nearby. As people fled from the threat, they reached exactly this place, the dragon helped the fugitives chase away their enemies and allowed them to build a city. From that day, Aldur the dragon is worshipped by the people who lives in the city.

Our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/fwxqc3uS2Q]https://discord.gg/fwxqc3uS2Q[/url]

[previewyoutube=C0t7mK70C_8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator - Engraving
notes.content:
Hello fellow blacksmiths,

Today we would like to show you a short video of our new engraving system.

You can design it with decals and physics items,

About Attachments
 You can buy blueprints and learn decals( once you learn them there is no limit of use) or you can buy decorations, basic one are in local shops, but for more sophisticated ones you need to wait for random events called "trainer from distant lands" which happens randomly so keep your money it's not gonna wait forever for you to buy it!

About the system:
 You can rotate a sword to be more precise,
 You can rotate and scale decorations, so that you can do it however you like,
 You can navigate the sword by moving and zooming to decorate as precisely as possible.

[previewyoutube=olInwAKlgEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/fwxqc3uS2Q]https://discord.gg/fwxqc3uS2Q[/url]

notes.title: Ironsmith Medieval Simulator - Devlog#1. Engraving System
notes.content:
[b]Hello there, blacksmiths.[/b]
From now on we will start the weekly devlogs, as we make progress we'll send you some sneak peeks of the features in our game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33905399/e4a91b8648188edf60cb97f896df1017638b6a9d.jpg[/img]
Video demonstration:
https://youtu.be/mdK0y_3XGV8

Today we would like to introduce you to engraving system in the game. Mainly, a sword is made of four components:

- Blade 
- Garde
- Handle
- Pommel

Each of these parts can be fully customised by engraving performed on working table. As the progress in the game goes forward, the player will eventually be able to unlock more features and styles to customise weapons in whatever style he likes.


What do you think about it? Is there anything else you want to see in engraving system or the game itself?
